subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` intentionally fail closed for changed text-model references whenever the current runtime resolver cannot validate them, rather than preserving the prior write-now/fail-later behavior?
rationale: The patch is designed around a user-visible compatibility and operator-contract change; tests can establish mechanics but cannot determine whether this stricter write-time policy is the desired product behavior for existing deployments.

options.title: Accept fail-closed validation
options.body: Approve immediate rejection of unresolved changed text-model references so invalid settings never reach persisted configuration.

options.title: Preserve write-time compatibility
options.body: Keep the existing permissive write behavior and surface resolver failures through validation or runtime diagnostics instead of blocking `config set`.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Approve immediate rejection of unresolved changed text-model references so invalid settings never reach persisted configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the concrete current review signal that this is a maintainer compatibility decision rather than a repairable implementation defect.
